title: 8 Things Scripture Calls Sin That You've Renamed a Personality Trait
caption:
A nicer name doesn't change what it is. It just makes it easier to keep.

Scripture doesn't say manage your sin. It says put it to death (Romans 8:13). Hard to kill something you've renamed into a strength.

Read through the list. One of these has your name on it disguised as a compliment you give yourself.

Which one did you catch first?
